atoms.text: Jeans were invented by Jacob Davis and Levis Strauss in 1873. Jacob Davis was a tailor, and Levis Strauss was a salesman. On the 20th of May, 1873, the two created the first pair of jeans. It all started during the Gold Rush, along the West Coast of the United States. At that time, many people were looking for gold in gold mines. And since they had to work all day with sharp stones, their trousers ripped quite often.
atoms.sound: ssml:Jeans were invented by Jacob Davis and Levis Strauss in 1873. Jacob Davis was a tailor, and Levis Strauss was a salesman. On the 20th of May, 1873, the two created the first pair of jeans. It all started during the Gold Rush, along the West Coast of the United States. At that time, many people were looking for gold in gold mines. And since they had to work all day with sharp stones, their trousers ripped quite often.

atoms.text: One day, a man who worked in a gold mine went to the tailor, Jacob Davis, to order a pair of more durable working trousers that wouldn’t rip as easily. So, Jacob Davis asked the salesman Levi Strauss for a durable cotton cloth, and luckily Strauss had one in stock. It was a fabric that was usually used for tents. Although the fabric was really thick, Jacob Davis was able to tailor a pair of trousers out of it. Those were the first jeans ever made.

atoms.text: Nowadays, jeans are worn by many men and women throughout the whole world. This was not always the case, though. For example, in 1863, the US city of San Francisco had a law that did not allow women to wear jeans.
atoms.sound: Nowadays, jeans are worn by many men and women throughout the whole world. This was not always the case though. For example, in 1863, the US city of San Francisco had a law that did not allow women to wear jeans.

atoms.text: Many other cities and states in the U.S. had similar laws which only allowed women to wear dresses or skirts. Therefore, jeans were mainly worn by men. In fact, most women did not start to wear jeans until the late 1950s.
